rules.rule: Writes nothing under the kb folder; every KB write is delegated to srd:kb
must: write\ any\ file\ under\ the\ `kb`\ folder
every\ knowledge\-base\ write\ is\ delegated\ there

rules.rule: Never publishes, authors SRDs, or files gaps itself; the sweep's gaps go through srd:report-doc-gap
must: publish\ anywhere;\ author\ or\ edit\ an\ SRD;\ file\ new\ gaps
`srd:report\-doc\-gap`\ owns\ that,\ the\ sweep's\ included

rules.rule: Pass the project gate before anything else
must: 0\.\ Pass\ the\ gate\.\ Always,\ before\ anything\ below

rules.rule: Every run sweeps REJECTED SRDs: one wrong gap per citing KB section through srd:report-doc-gap, filed at once, skipping a section an open revert gap covers
must: 1\.\ Sweep\ `REJECTED`\ SRDs\.\ Always,\ any\ list\ named\.
already\ reverts\ it\ —\ skip\ the\ section,\ no\ hit
`REJECTED`\ Status\ is\ the\ confirmation:\ no\ proposal,\ no\ grill
naming\ the\ rejected\ SRD\ and\ every\ other\ SRD\ the\ attestation\ line\ names

rules.rule: Every run re-checks stale gaps: refresh with the same refs only when the sections still state the fact, correct a moved ref, reopen a filled gap whose fact is gone, ask when unsure
must: 2\.\ Re\-check\ stale\ gaps\.\ Always,\ any\ list\ named\.
`complete:\ true`\ refreshes\ a\ filled\ gap,\ `complete:\ false`\ re\-hashes\ an\ open\ one
else\ `reopen_gap`,\ `reason`\ what\ changed
none\ hold:\ no\ call
Never\ refresh\ on\ a\ guess

rules.rule: Only the user closes an unknown; a corpus hit is evidence, never closure
must: Only\ the\ user\ closes\ an\ unknown
a\ hit\ is\ evidence\ to\ put\ in\ front\ of\ them,\ never\ a\ closure

rules.rule: Never invent an answer to close a gap
must: Never\ invent\ an\ answer\ to\ close\ a\ gap
closed\ with\ a\ guess\ is\ a\ fact\ the\ corpus\ will\ serve\ as\ truth

rules.rule: Every sentence of a draft is user-confirmed or corpus-stated
must: Do\ not\ draft\ from\ guesses
every\ sentence\ of\ the\ draft\ is\ something\ the\ user\ confirmed\ or\ the\ corpus\ states

rules.rule: Drafts go outside every corpus source, kb included
must: outside\ every\ corpus\ source
a\ draft\ inside\ a\ source\ is\ clobbered\ by\ the\ next\ sync

rules.rule: Fill only from a corpus section get_doc shows; a URL or unpulled draft fills nothing
must: Fill\ once\ a\ corpus\ section\ states\ the\ fact\ and\ `get_doc`\ shows\ it
A\ URL\ never\ fills\ a\ gap
fill\ nothing

rules.rule: Never fill against _inbox.md or an unconfirmed fact; part of the fact is a partial fill
must: Never\ fill\ against\ `_inbox\.md`
Never\ fill\ against\ an\ unconfirmed\ fact
`complete:\ false`\ with\ `remaining`\ saying\ what\ is\ still\ missing

rules.rule: Wontfix only on the user's decision, never to clear the list
must: Wontfix\ only\ on\ the\ user's\ decision
Never\ to\ clear\ the\ list

rules.rule: A deferred gap with no answer becomes an unknown via update_gap, not a skip
must: No\ answer\ exists:\ it\ is\ an\ unknown,\ not\ a\ skip\ —\ `update_gap`\ with\ `answer:\ unknown`

rules.rule: An answered deferred gap goes to srd:kb, loses its answer mark, and fills only once a topic page states it
must: hand\ the\ fact\ to\ `srd:kb`\ with\ the\ gap's\ id,\ then\ `update_gap`\ `answer:\ ""`
`srd:kb`\ writes\ to\ its\ inbox,\ never\ a\ fill\ target

rules.rule: Report names delegates by count and never states the answers
must: Never\ say\ what\ the\ answers\ were\ or\ where\ they\ landed
`srd:kb:\ 2\ answers`

rules.rule: A store error stops gaps work; no retry
must: report\ it\ with\ its\ message\ and\ stop;\ never\ retry\ it\ or\ work\ around\ it

rules.rule: filled_by entries use the result's id copied as is, never its path
must: the\ identity\ is\ the\ result's\ `id`\ from\ `search`\ or\ `list_docs`,\ copied\ as\ is,\ never\ its\ `path`

rules.rule: No hard-coded trust order or folder name
